quarterly_data.quarter: INNIO press release: INNIO Completes Acquisition of Enerflex APAC Aftermarket (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: INNIO completed its acquisition of Enerflex Ltd.'s aftermarket business operations in Australia, Thailand and Indonesia, strengthening its Asia-Pacific presence with local service capabilities and greater customer proximity. The acquired business operates principally across three countries and eight locations, with workshop and office facilities, an experienced workforce and an installed base supported by long-term service agreements with major oil and gas companies in the region.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: seller of the acquired APAC aftermarket operations
